purpose: Describe and falsify the frozen capitulation_d1 edge without changing its production rule.
frozen_signal: daily body below -2 percent and close below population Bollinger lower band 20,2
canonical_execution: signal on day t close; enter t+1 open; exit t+1 close
diagnostics_not_selection: next-open to close returns after 1,2,3,5 sessions
MAE and MFE from entry open
lagged 20-day volatility above or below its expanding median

risk_policy.rule: Leverage is capped below the buffered worst observed MAE barrier; notional is capped by the current capital-tier risk divided by stop distance and by margin independently.

limitations: Yahoo OHLC is not certified as raw Ostium OHLC; MSFT close-only parity does not certify open/high/low.
QQQ is only a research proxy for NDXUSD.
Descriptive holding-period and regime results cannot authorize a production rule change.
No holdout is opened and no paper/live strategy is modified by this audit.
